speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your specific symptoms regarding the gait and limb ataxia you mentioned, and tell me about your significant medical history.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for describing the symptoms. To narrow down the cause of your ataxia, could you tell me if you experience any other neurological signs like numbness, weakness, speech difficulties, or vision changes? Also, do you recall any specific trauma or recent infections?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) due to natalizumab therapy.
